**Login** — `frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`, `login(username)` (line 16): no password/server check — it's name-only. It looks up `ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>` in `localStorage`; if found, loads that `UserProfile`; otherwise creates a fresh `{username, campaigns: []}` and persists it. Active profile is also cached under `ai_dnd_user`.

**Campaigns storage** — Not in D1/server at all; they live purely client-side as `CampaignSlot[]` on the `UserProfile`, under `localStorage` keys `ai_dnd_user_<name>` (per-user) and `ai_dnd_user` (active session), managed by `addCampaign()`/`updateCampaign()`/`removeCampaign()` in the same file. Each slot just points at a Worker session/character via `location`.

**Deleting a campaign slot** — `removeCampaign(slotId)` (line 54) only filters the slot out of `profile.campaigns` and re-persists to `localStorage`. It makes **no API call to the Worker**: the server-side character and session data in D1/KV are untouched and orphaned — the local pointer is gone, but the data remains on the server.
